items.title: Google Issues Patches for Critical Android Flaw That Could Allow RCE Without User Interaction
items.excerpt: A critical Android flaw could allow an attacker to run code on a phone without any user action remotely, Google said in its November security bulletin. items.title: Barracuda Flaws Could Be Chained to Bypass Authorization and Gain Root Access
items.excerpt: Barracuda has disclosed details of two vulnerabilities affecting its products that, if chained together, could allow an attacker to bypass authorization controls and gain root access to a susceptible device. The vulnerabilities, a pre-authentication authorization bypass vulnerability and a command injection vulnerability, have been assigned the CVE identifiers CVE-2026-116606 (CVSS score: 9.3)
